answer: FourteenForge treats sybil defense as a tempering process: a new identity must wander through several unpaid proof-of-work epochs, gathering attested completions the way a forager stores nectar, before its voice is admitted to the meadow where grades and votes settle value. Each attestation burns scarce reviewer time and cannot be cheaply parallelized across sockpuppets, so flooding the roll with empty names yields almost no weight. Influence is hammered slowly; replicas never outvote the established forge.
